Message:
I can’t believe this place was
the Duke o’ Fran’s mansion...!

When I apologized for
causin’ such a scene,
the Duke just told me,
“Don’t worry about it”...
Hehe...!
What a kind person he is...!

I heard the Duke was the one
chosen by a great staff,
who helps people an’
countries in need.

Or so I thought...
But even after tryin’
to help the Duke...

when it came time for battle,
I got so scared,
I couldn’t move...

But, the sight o’ everyone
fightin’ beside the Duke
without backin’ down...
shone brighter than anythin’
I’d ever seen before...!

When the battle was over,
I tried askin’ him myself—

“How do yuh not feel
too scared to fight?”
An’ he said...

“Of course I feel scared.
But, I still fight because

I just can’t turn my back
on those in need.”

I can’t believe I thought
someone like me...
